avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces propafenone levels and efficacy; may precipitate arrhythmias
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before adding

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases propafenone levels and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use; switch to alternative supplements if needed

avoid_supplements.name: High-Dose Vitamin K Supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May antagonize anticoagulation if propafenone used with warfarin; increases thrombotic risk
avoid_supplements.action: Maintain consistent intake; monitor INR closely if concurrent anticoagulation

caution_supplements.name: Quercetin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition; theoretical increase in propafenone exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects (dizziness, tremor); report symptoms to prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4; modest effect on propafenone metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation; monitor for increased propafenone effects

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance cardiac effects and prolong QT interval additively
caution_supplements.action: Monitor ECG parameters; use standard recommended doses only

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition dramatically increases propafenone serum levels and bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and products; choose alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases propafenone absorption and peak serum levels; may enhance both efficacy and side effects
caution_foods.action: Take with consistent meal timing/fat content; maintain stable dosing pattern

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (Broccoli, Cabbage)
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP1A2 induction with high intake may slightly reduce propafenone levels
caution_foods.action: Consume in normal dietary amounts; excessive intake should be avoided

monitoring_notes: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and ECG parameters (QRS, QT intervals) regularly as propafenone is a potent sodium channel blocker with proarrhythmic potential. Adjust monitoring intensity if CYP2D6 inhibitor supplements or medications are added, as propafenone metabolism is significantly affected by this pathway.
